summary: Verified re-fix for the /sell 'View on Google Maps' bug (nested-URL / refused-to-connect). MapCoordsField.parseCoords() correctly extracts lat,lng from all 5 input formats (raw coords with/without space, ?q= URL, /maps/@ URL, /maps/place/ URL) and produces a CLEAN `https://www.google.com/maps?q=-9.4438,147.1803` href in every case. Actually clicked the preview for case (c) (the original bug) — new tab opened at exactly https://www.google.com/maps?q=-9.4438,147.1803 with NO 'refused to connect' error. rel='noopener noreferrer' and target='_blank' present. Button label reads 'View on Google Maps'. Invalid inputs ('not-a-coord', 'blah blah') render [data-testid=sell_form-map-coords-invalid] with helpful message and NO preview link. Empty input renders neither. Resolved-URL text exactly 'Opens: https://www.google.com/maps?q=<coords>'. Regression: prefix testid = 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=', help text contains expected copy. Admin property modal: pasting full Google Maps URL into property-map-coords-input yields clean property-map-coords-preview href. Backend: created TEST_MapCoords_Property via POST /api/properties with map_coords set to full URL — stored raw as-is; public /property/<id> detail-map-btn resolves to clean 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=-9.4438,147.1803'. Cleanup DELETE succeeded (404 after). Contact page /contact contact-view-map-btn works with target=_blank, href starts with https://www.google.com/maps?q= (no maps iframe; only a stray 1x1 hidden dev iframe with empty src, unrelated). Backend regression: pytest test_captcha.py + test_page_content.py + test_map_coords.py -> 32/33 passed (same pre-existing flake in test_team_list_append_and_delete, unrelated). Admin login (admin@trel.com.pg / Admin@123) works via API and UI.

critical_code_review_comments: parseCoords regex `/(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[,\s/]\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/` correctly matches lat/lng pairs in raw coords, ?q= URLs, /maps/@ URLs, and /maps/place/ URLs. Boundary validation (|lat|<=90, |lng|<=180) is present.
MapCoordsField label 'View on Google Maps' now consistent with user terminology and matches Contact + PropertyDetail buttons.
mapsUrlFromCoords normalizes internally, so any consumer (PropertyDetail, Contact fallback) is safe against a full-URL being stored in map_coords.

rca of the issue: Original bug RCA: Users pasted full Google Maps URLs into a coords field whose code URL-encoded the entire value and re-appended it after '?q=', producing nested/double-encoded URLs that Chrome refused. Fix: MapCoordsField.parseCoords() runs a lat/lng regex on ANY input (raw coords OR pasted URL) and rebuilds a clean `https://www.google.com/maps?q=lat,lng`. Preview link is only rendered when parse succeeds; invalid input shows a warning instead. mapsUrlFromCoords() applies the same normalization to legacy stored map_coords values (full URLs) on Contact + PropertyDetail buttons.
